stories.title: Former Birgunj mayor Sarawagi leaves UML
stories.summary: Kathmandu, October 9 Vijay Kumar Sarawagi, former mayor of Birgunj Metropolitan City, has announced that he is leaving the CPN-UML. Sarawagi announced his departure from the UML on Facebook. “I hereby inform everyone that, effective today, I have given up all responsibilities, and I am no longer a general member of CPN-UML,” he wrote. The post Former Birgunj mayor Sarawagi leaves UML appeared first on OnlineKhabar English News .
